meta.title: 松弛感四要素｜跟僵硬姿态说拜拜
meta.title_en: Four Elements of Effortless Poses — Goodbye Stiffness

scenes.title_cn: 要素一·胳膊要弯：想拍出松弛感，只需…
scenes.title_en: Element one · bend the arms: to look effor…
sentences: 想拍出松弛感，只需要做对四件事。
To look effortless, you only need to get four things right.
four elements（四要素）
过直的胳膊会让动作僵化，弯一点看起来会更加松弛。
Straight arms stiffen the pose; a slight bend looks more relaxed.
bend the arms（胳膊要弯）
scenes.speak: To look effortless, you only need to get four things right. Straight arms stiffen the pose; a slight bend looks more relaxed.

scenes.title_cn: 要素二·手腕要弯：比起手腕上翘，下垂…
scenes.title_en: Element two · bend the wrists: compared wi…
sentences: 比起手腕上翘，下垂的手型看起来就放松多了。
Compared with cocked wrists, a drooping hand looks more relaxed.
drooping wrist（手腕下垂）
scenes.speak: Compared with cocked wrists, a drooping hand looks more relaxed.

scenes.title_cn: 要素三·脖子要歪：头太正会显得过于正…
scenes.title_en: Element three · tilt the neck: an overly s…
sentences: 头太正会显得过于正式，又不是在拍证件照。
An overly straight head looks too formal—you're not at an ID photo.
too formal（过于正式）
只要歪一歪头，效果可就不一样了。
Just tilt the head a little and the effect changes.
tilt the head（歪头）
scenes.speak: An overly straight head looks too formal—you're not at an ID photo. Just tilt the head a little and the effect changes.

scenes.title_cn: 要素四·膝盖要弯：站着拍就不要站太直…
scenes.title_en: Element four · bend the knees: don't stand…
sentences: 站着拍就不要站太直了。
Don't stand bolt upright when shooting.
don't stand straight（别站太直）
单腿屈膝会显得更舒展，坐着也是一样。
A single bent knee looks more relaxed—same when sitting.
bent knee（屈膝）
scenes.speak: Don't stand bolt upright when shooting. A single bent knee looks more relaxed—same when sitting.

practice: Bend the arms to avoid stiffness.
Let the hands droop instead of cocking up.
Tilt the head to avoid a formal look.
Bend one knee when standing or sitting.
pitfalls: Bend them slightly for an effortless look.
Let the hands droop for a relaxed look.
手腕下垂比上翘更放松。
Bend one knee for an extended look.
shifts: 用 stiffen（僵化）、relaxed（松弛）、effortless（松弛感）
用 bend the arms（弯胳膊）、droop the wrist（手腕下垂）、tilt the head（歪头）
用 extended（舒展）、formal（正式）、ID photo（证件照）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播。已校正：松弛感、四件事、胳膊要弯、过直僵化、弯一点松弛、手腕要弯、上翘、下垂、放松、脖子要歪、头太正正式、歪一歪头、膝盖要弯、站太直、单腿屈膝、舒展、坐着也一样等。
